summary: This Phase 3 study looks at a drug called eloralintide to see how it affects body weight in adults with overweight or obesity and type 2 diabetes. Eli Lilly and Company is sponsoring the research, which aims to enroll 1035 participants. The study is currently Recruiting. Overweight means having a body mass index, or BMI, of 27 or higher, and obesity means having an even higher BMI.
